## Configurable defaults and audio track control

- Enabled metadata stripping by default and moved the requested video dimensions into `config.ini`: 2900 pixels for the 4K tier and 1890 pixels for the 1080p tier.
- Streaming now defaults to HEVC Main10 and uses NVENC CQ 33 for the 4K output tier.
- With surround retention enabled, each multichannel source track and its generated stereo downmix can be included independently.
- Updated the urgent update policy to require version 2.10.2.
